CO2 Fractional Laser

CO2 fractional laser is one of the most effective treatments for acne scars, deep wrinkles, stretch marks and rough skin. At Facelit we use an advanced US FDA-cleared dual laser that pairs fractional CO2 with Erbium Glass 1550nm, so you get strong resurfacing with less downtime and faster healing. Every session is planned and done by our doctors.

2-in-1CO2 + 1550nm laser

Treatment overview

What is CO2 Fractional Laser?

A CO2 laser uses a beam of light that water in your skin absorbs strongly, so it can gently vaporise a very thin layer of damaged skin. "Fractional" means the beam is split into thousands of microscopic dots. Only those dots are treated, while the healthy skin around them stays untouched and speeds up healing.

Each tiny treated spot triggers your skin's repair process. Over the following weeks and months, it replaces scarred and damaged tissue with new collagen and fresh skin. That is why CO2 fractional laser is often called the gold standard for acne scars and skin resurfacing.

Read more: how our CO2 laser works

At Facelit we use the CO2 + Erbium Glass 1550nm Dual Laser, a single machine with two laser sources. Your doctor can adjust:

  • Depth, to reach shallow texture or deeper scar tissue.
  • Density, meaning how many dots are placed per square centimetre.
  • Energy, set differently for the face, neck and body.
  • Pattern and size, so small areas like individual scars can be targeted.
  • Wavelength, switching between CO2, Erbium Glass or both in one session.

Built-in cooling and safety features keep you comfortable and lower the risk of side effects. Want to know more? Read how CO2 laser improves your skin.

1. Micro-columnsThe laser treats thousands of tiny dots, leaving healthy skin in between.
2. HealingHealthy skin around each dot repairs it within days.
3. Collagen remodellingNew collagen builds for 3 to 6 months, smoothing scars and lines.

Our technology

Meet Our CO2 + Erbium Glass 1550nm Laser

Not all CO2 lasers are the same. Ours combines two lasers in one machine, so your doctor can choose exactly how deep and how strong each treatment should be.

US FDA-cleared

CO2 + Erbium Glass 1550nm Dual Laser

This dual-wavelength system brings together a fractional CO2 laser, the gold standard for resurfacing, and a 1550nm Erbium Glass laser that stimulates collagen deep in the skin without breaking the surface. Using both in one session means strong results for scars and wrinkles, with less downtime and faster healing than CO2 alone.

US FDA-clearedDual wavelengthLess downtimeFaster healingFace & body
10,600 nmFractional CO2 for resurfacing scars, wrinkles and texture
1,550 nmErbium Glass for deep, gentle collagen building
AdjustableDepth, density and spot size set for every area
PreciseScanner treats tiny dots and leaves healthy skin in between
See the full machine details

Three modes, one machine

The CO2 beam removes thousands of microscopic columns of damaged skin and heats the layers below. As each column heals, scarred and wrinkled skin is replaced with fresh tissue and new collagen. This is the most powerful mode for deep acne scars, surgical scars and stretch marks.

  • Strongest results for deep scars
  • Resurfaces rough, uneven skin
  • Also removes moles, skin tags and xanthelasma precisely
Best for: deep acne scars, surgical and burn scars, stretch marks
Downtime: 5–7 days
Sessions: 3–5, every 4–6 weeks

The 1550nm Erbium Glass laser is non-ablative. It passes through the surface without removing it and gently heats deeper layers to trigger collagen. The skin surface stays intact, so recovery is quick and the risk of pigmentation is lower.

  • Very little downtime
  • Gentler on Indian and darker skin
  • Good for pores, fine lines, melasma and mild scars
Best for: pores, fine lines, mild scars, pigmentation
Downtime: 1–2 days of redness
Sessions: 4–6, every 3–4 weeks

Our doctors can use both wavelengths in the same session: Erbium Glass to build collagen deep down and CO2 to resurface the top layers. You get much of the power of CO2 with a shorter, easier recovery, which is why this is our most recommended option for acne scars.

  • Deep collagen plus surface renewal
  • Less downtime than CO2 alone
  • Our go-to option for acne scars and texture
Best for: acne scars, wrinkles, overall resurfacing
Downtime: 3–5 days
Sessions: 3–5, every 4–6 weeks

What to expect

Benefits of CO2 Fractional Laser

One technology, many results. Here is what a course of CO2 laser can do for your skin.

Smoother Acne Scars

Breaks up old scar tissue and fills in rolling and boxcar scars with fresh collagen.

Softer Wrinkles

Smooths fine lines around the eyes, mouth and forehead.

Firmer, Tighter Skin

Heat from the laser tightens collagen, giving skin a gentle lift.

Smaller-looking Pores

Tightens stretched pores on the nose and cheeks.

Faded Stretch Marks

Improves the colour and texture of stretch marks on the tummy, thighs and arms.

Flatter, Lighter Scars

Softens accident, surgical, burn and chickenpox scars.

Smooth, Even Texture

Resurfaces rough, bumpy or sun-damaged skin so it looks polished.

Results That Keep Improving

Collagen keeps building for 3 to 6 months after each session.

Swipe to see more

Is it right for you?

What Can CO2 Fractional Laser Treat?

Tap a concern to see how the laser helps, what we might combine it with and roughly how many sessions it takes.

Acne scars

Acne scars are where CO2 fractional laser really shines. The laser makes thousands of tiny columns in the scarred skin. As each one heals, your skin lays down new collagen that lifts and smooths rolling and boxcar scars. Deep ice-pick scars often need a little help from TCA CROSS or subcision first.

  • Lifts rolling and boxcar scars
  • Evens out bumpy texture
  • Fades leftover acne marks
Often combined withSubcisionTCA CROSSPRP
Typical sessions3–5, every 4–6 weeks
Laser treatment for deep acne scars

Enlarged, open pores

Pores look bigger as skin loses firmness and oil stretches them out. CO2 resurfacing tightens the skin around each pore and smooths the surface, so pores look visibly smaller, especially on the nose and cheeks.

  • Tighter, smaller-looking pores
  • Smoother skin surface
  • Makeup sits better
Often combined withChemical peelMNRF
Typical sessions2–4, every 4–6 weeks
Open pores treatment

Wrinkles & fine lines

As we age, collagen slows down and lines start to settle in. CO2 laser removes a thin layer of damaged skin and kick-starts collagen production, softening crow's feet, smile lines and lines on the forehead and around the lips.

  • Softens crow's feet and smile lines
  • Improves crepey under-eye skin
  • Brighter, fresher-looking skin
Often combined withBotoxSkin boosters
Typical sessions2–4, every 4–6 weeks
Anti-ageing treatments

Stretch marks

Stretch marks form when skin stretches faster than it can keep up, during pregnancy, growth spurts or weight changes. The laser remodels the damaged skin so marks become flatter, narrower and closer to your normal skin colour. Newer, pinkish marks respond fastest.

  • Narrower, flatter marks
  • Colour closer to your skin tone
  • Works on tummy, thighs, hips and arms
Often combined withPRPMNRF
Typical sessions3–6, every 4–6 weeks
Stretch mark treatments

Accident, surgical & burn scars

Raised, uneven or discoloured scars from injuries, surgery or burns can be made flatter and softer. The laser breaks down thick scar tissue and helps your skin rebuild it in a more organised way, so the scar blends better with the skin around it.

  • Flattens raised and thick scars
  • Softens stiff scar tissue
  • Blends scar colour and texture
Often combined withSteroid injectionSilicone gel
Typical sessions3–6, every 4–8 weeks
Removing accident scars

Rough, uneven or sun-damaged skin

Sun damage, old breakouts and age can leave skin rough and dull. Fractional CO2 resurfacing replaces that worn-out surface with smoother, healthier skin, improving texture, tone and glow in one go.

  • Smoother, softer surface
  • Fades sun spots
  • Healthier glow
Often combined withChemical peelHydraFacial
Typical sessions1–3, every 4–6 weeks
How CO2 laser improves skin

Pigmentation & melasma

Pigmentation needs a gentle hand, because too much heat can make it worse. Here we use the Erbium Glass 1550nm mode at careful settings to break up pigment and renew the skin, usually alongside peels and a prescribed home routine.

  • Gentle, non-ablative approach
  • Fades sun spots and patchy tone
  • Lower risk for Indian skin
Often combined withChemical peelsPico laser
Typical sessions4–6, every 3–4 weeks
Peels for pigmentation

Moles, skin tags & xanthelasma

The CO2 laser can precisely remove small benign growths like skin tags, flat moles, warts and xanthelasma (yellowish patches near the eyelids). It seals as it works, so there is very little bleeding and healing is neat. Every mole is checked by a doctor before removal.

  • Quick, precise removal
  • Minimal bleeding
  • Small spot heals in 7 to 10 days
ImportantDoctor check before removal
Typical sessionsUsually 1
Skin tag removal

Loose or sagging skin

The heat from a CO2 laser makes existing collagen contract and tells your skin to build more. The result is a subtle, natural tightening that improves firmness on the face, neck and under the eyes, without surgery.

  • Firmer cheeks and jawline
  • Tighter skin under the eyes
  • Natural-looking results
Often combined withHIFUMNRF
Typical sessions2–3, every 6 weeks
Skin tightening options

Your appointment

CO2 Laser Procedure: Step by Step

Good preparation makes the treatment safer and the results better.

  • Your doctor examines your skin, asks about your medical history and agrees a plan with you.
  • Stop retinoids, scrubs and exfoliating acids 5 to 7 days before.
  • Avoid sun exposure and tanning for at least 2 weeks before.
  • Darker skin may need 2 to 4 weeks of priming creams to lower the risk of pigmentation.
  • If you get cold sores, you may be given antiviral tablets to start beforehand.
  • Come with clean skin, no makeup or lotions.

The treatment itself takes 15 to 30 minutes, plus time for numbing.

  • A numbing cream is applied for 45 to 60 minutes, then removed.
  • You wear protective eye shields throughout.
  • The doctor moves the laser handpiece over the area in planned passes.
  • You will feel warmth and a prickly, pins-and-needles sensation.
  • A cooling device or cold compress keeps you comfortable.
  • A soothing ointment and sunscreen are applied before you leave.

Your skin will feel like it has a sunburn for a day or two. The full aftercare plan is below.

  • Expect redness, warmth and mild swelling for 1 to 3 days.
  • Skin may look slightly bronzed and feel rough, like sandpaper, as tiny dots form.
  • Gentle flaking follows around day 3 to 7. Don't pick it.
  • Keep the area clean and moisturised with the ointment you are given.
  • Stay out of the sun and use SPF 50 once your doctor says it's fine.
  • Avoid makeup, workouts, swimming and saunas until your skin has healed.

Recovery & results

CO2 Laser Recovery and Results

Everyone heals a little differently, but this is what most people go through after a moderate session on the face.

  1. Day 1–2

    Red & warm

    Skin feels like a sunburn, with some swelling, especially around the eyes.

  2. Day 3–7

    Bronzing & flaking

    Skin darkens slightly and flakes off in fine, tiny pieces as it renews.

  3. Week 2

    Fresh, pink skin

    New skin looks smoother and slightly pink, which fades over a few weeks.

  4. Months 1–6

    Collagen builds

    Scars, lines and texture keep improving as new collagen forms.

Aftercare

CO2 Laser Aftercare

Careful aftercare speeds up healing and protects your results.

Do

  • Cleanse gently with cool water and a mild cleanser
  • Apply the healing ointment several times a day
  • Use cold packs wrapped in cloth for swelling
  • Sleep with your head slightly raised

Avoid

  • Makeup and any active skincare
  • Hot showers, steam, saunas and workouts
  • Direct sun, even for short trips
  • Touching or scratching your skin

Do

  • Keep moisturising. Flaking is normal
  • Switch to a gentle moisturiser once flaking stops
  • Start mineral sunscreen when your doctor says so
  • Drink plenty of water

Avoid

  • Pulling off flakes or crusts
  • Swimming pools and the beach
  • Waxing, threading or facials
  • Retinoids and acids for 2 weeks

Morning

  • Gentle cleanser
  • Brightening or antioxidant serum, when allowed
  • Moisturiser
  • SPF 50, reapplied outdoors

Night

  • Gentle cleanser
  • Prescribed cream if you are prone to pigmentation
  • Barrier-repair moisturiser
  • Follow-up visit before your next session

Your skin type

Is CO2 Laser Right for Your Skin?

Indian and darker skin tones
CO2 laser is safe for darker skin, but there is a higher chance of temporary darkening (post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation). We lower that risk with skin priming, gentler settings, wider gaps between sessions and strict sun protection. For some people we may suggest MNRF instead.
Oily, acne-prone skin
Wait until active acne is under control before starting, as the laser works best on scars rather than active pimples. We can treat breakouts first with peels or medication.
Sensitive skin
We start with lighter settings and check how your skin reacts before moving to stronger passes.
Mature skin
CO2 is excellent for lines, loose skin and sun damage. Results often look best when combined with skin boosters or HIFU.
Recently tanned skin
Let your tan settle for at least 2 to 4 weeks before treatment. Laser on tanned skin raises the risk of pigmentation.

Safety first

CO2 Laser Side Effects and Who Should Wait

In experienced hands, CO2 fractional laser is safe. Here is what is normal and when it is better to wait.

Common and temporary

  • Redness and warmth for 2 to 5 days, with pinkness that fades over a few weeks
  • Mild swelling, especially around the eyes
  • Flaking and a sandpaper feel for 3 to 7 days
  • Temporary darkening in some darker skin types, which we treat with creams
  • Itching as the skin heals

Talk to your doctor first if you

  • Are pregnant or breastfeeding
  • Have taken oral isotretinoin in the last 6 months
  • Have active acne, infection, cold sores or eczema on the area
  • Tend to form keloids
  • Have a fresh tan or sunburn
  • Have diabetes, a bleeding disorder or take blood thinners

Questions

CO2 Fractional Laser FAQs

Does CO2 fractional laser hurt?
We apply a numbing cream for 45 to 60 minutes before the treatment, so most people feel only warmth and a prickly, pins-and-needles sensation. Afterwards your skin feels like it has a mild sunburn for a day or two.
How many CO2 laser sessions will I need?
Most people need 3 to 5 sessions spaced 4 to 6 weeks apart. Light texture concerns may need just 1 or 2, while deep acne scars or stretch marks usually need more. Your doctor will give you a plan after examining your skin.
What is the downtime after CO2 fractional laser?
With our combined CO2 and Erbium Glass mode, most people have 3 to 5 days of redness and flaking. A strong CO2-only session can take 5 to 7 days, and Erbium Glass alone just 1 to 2. Most people plan their session before a weekend or a few days off.
Which laser machine does Facelit use?
We use a CO2 + Erbium Glass 1550nm Dual Laser. It combines a fractional CO2 laser (10,600nm) with a non-ablative Erbium Glass laser (1550nm) in one device, so treatment can be tailored to your skin and how much downtime you can take.
Is your laser FDA-cleared?
Yes. The technology we use is US FDA-cleared, and every treatment is carried out by our doctors following strict safety protocols.
What does the Erbium Glass 1550nm laser add?
It builds collagen deep in the skin without damaging the surface. On its own it gives gentle, low-downtime rejuvenation. Combined with CO2, it lets us get strong results with a lighter CO2 setting, which means quicker healing.
When will I see results?
Your skin looks smoother and brighter once it has healed, usually in 1 to 2 weeks. The bigger change comes over the next 3 to 6 months as new collagen builds, so results keep improving long after each session.
Is CO2 laser safe for Indian or darker skin?
Yes, with the right approach. Darker skin has a higher risk of temporary darkening after laser, so we use carefully chosen settings, prime your skin with creams for 2 to 4 weeks beforehand and insist on strict sun protection afterwards.
Are the results permanent?
Scars that have been improved stay improved. Your skin will keep ageing naturally, so for wrinkles and texture many people choose a maintenance session every year or so, along with good sunscreen and skincare.
What is the difference between CO2 laser and MNRF?
CO2 laser removes tiny columns of the skin's surface and heats deeper layers, so it is excellent for scars and texture but has more downtime. MNRF uses fine needles with radiofrequency energy under the skin, so it has less downtime and suits darker skin well. We often combine the two.
Can CO2 laser remove acne scars completely?
It can improve acne scars a lot, often by 50 to 80 percent over a full course, but it rarely erases them completely. Combining it with subcision, TCA CROSS or PRP usually gives the best result.
Can I wear makeup after the treatment?
Wait until your skin has fully stopped flaking, usually 5 to 7 days. Makeup on freshly treated skin can irritate it and slow down healing.
Can CO2 laser be done on the body?
Yes. We treat stretch marks on the tummy, thighs and arms, and scars on any part of the body. Body skin heals a little slower than the face, so downtime is often a few days longer.
When is the best time of year for CO2 laser?
Any time, as long as you can avoid direct sun while you heal. Many people prefer the monsoon or cooler months in Kerala, when it is easier to stay out of strong sunlight.
Where can I get CO2 fractional laser in Kerala?
Facelit offers CO2 fractional laser at our clinic in Kowdiar, Trivandrum, with clinics also in Karunagappally and Guruvayur. Book online or call your nearest clinic to check availability.
How much does CO2 fractional laser cost?
The cost depends on the area being treated, the concern and how many sessions you need. Book a consultation and we will give you a clear, personalised quote.
